description.value: Pita Land is a Canadian Middle Eastern restaurant chain that has been serving shawarma, pita wraps, and traditional Mideast cuisine since 2003, drawing on generations of family recipes. The Nanaimo location sits in a strip mall on Terminal Avenue North and offers a broad menu of wraps, rice bowls, plates, burgers, salads, and desserts. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient stop for a filling, flavour-forward meal with both dine-in and online ordering options.
